market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to more than triple from current ~$33 to a never-before-seen $120 by June 2026. Even the historic 2010–2011 surge only reached ~$48, and the all-time high near $50 has held for over four decades. A move to $120 in 15 months requires extreme and unprecedented circumstances, making a true probability well below the market's 6.6%.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50; $120 would be a 140% increase over that record.
Silver futures currently trade around $33, requiring a ~260% gain in ~1.3 years — a pace never sustained in modern history.
Even the most bullish silver narratives (industrial demand, inflation) have not produced a price target remotely near $120 in mainstream forecasts.
sources_consulted: Knowledge of silver historical prices and futures settlement
CME Silver (SI) futures contract specifications and recent price data
Macroeconomic analysis of precious metals bull markets
